training_data.labeling: weak supervision from Phase 1 taxonomy rules, Phase 2 multiplier cues, and aggregate non-PII context metadata
training_data.limitation: Dataset is rebuilt from local raw public archives and remains weak-labeled; metrics are exploratory and not production-grade.

model_approaches.name: deep_learning_transformer
model_approaches.blocked_by: requires human-adjudicated labels before meaningful fine-tuning

red_team_cases.expected_behavior: low score unless conditionality or private contact cues appear

red_team_cases.case: Financial offer plus private channel and discretion
red_team_cases.expected_behavior: high risk tags for financial, migration, and privacy multipliers

best_approaches: TF-IDF one-vs-rest logistic regression is the best trained model currently possible with 5717 weakly labeled records.
Rule-based evidence spans remain more explainable than the trained classifier while labels are weakly supervised.
Aggregate visibility and engagement metadata provide useful context labels without storing profile-level PII.
limitations: Labels are weakly supervised, not human annotated.
No deep learning model was fine-tuned because human-adjudicated labels are not yet available.
Metrics are exploratory and should not be treated as production performance.
failure_modes: May miss slang, image-only ads, and heavily obfuscated contact text.
May confuse legitimate aid discussions with exploitative offers.
